standard-dialogue-before-recruiting.player: What are you waiting here for?

standard-dialogue-before-recruiting.npc: I'm looking for an adventure! This place is meant to be the perfect place to find one for a budding pirate like me!

standard-dialogue-before-recruiting.player: I see. Well, I've never really had to look for an adventure myself. Personally I find I just stumble into them instead.

standard-dialogue-before-recruiting.text: If the player has not completed Pandemonium:

steps.npc: Really? Well, I hope that happens to me soon!

steps.player: I'm sure it will. Good luck!

standard-dialogue-before-recruiting.npc: Really? Well, perhaps I'd be better off sticking with you then.

standard-dialogue-before-recruiting.text: If the player does not have 40 Sailing:

steps.player: Sorry, but I'm still pretty new to it all. I don't think I'm ready to be hiring a crew yet, but I'll let you know when I am.

steps.text: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.

standard-dialogue-before-recruiting.text: If the player has at least 40 Sailing:

options.text: I'd definitely be happy to have you on my crew.

steps.player: I'd definitely be happy to have you on my crew.

steps.text: If the player does not have 55 Sailing:

steps.npc: Hang on... You don't actually look like much of an adventurer to me. I don't think this will work.

steps.text: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 55 Sailing.

steps.npc: Great! I reckon this will be a fun adventure! I'll see you on your boat...

steps.text: You recruit Adventurer Ada as a crew member.
You have recruited Adventurer Ada as a crew member.

options.text: Sorry, but I'm not really in a place for you to join me right now.

steps.player: Sorry, but I'm not really in a place for you to join me right now.

subsequent-dialogue-before-recruiting.npc: Hello again! Reckon you're ready for me to join you yet?

subsequent-dialogue-before-recruiting.text: If the player does not have 40 Sailing:
If the player has at least 40 Sailing:

when-at-the-pandemonium-after-joining-cr.player: Hey there. How are you enjoying being part of the crew?

when-at-the-pandemonium-after-joining-cr.npc: I'm looking forward to the next adventure! I might start writing down what we get up to.

when-at-the-pandemonium-after-joining-cr.player: Well, that might save me a bit of time on my captain's log.
